AAPL.name: Apple Inc.
AAPL.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services.
AAPL.moat: Ecosystem lock-in, proprietary silicon, brand loyalty, and massive recurring high-margin services revenue.
AAPL.invalidation_criteria: Sustained decline in active device installed base, loss of app store commission structure, or failure in edge AI monetization.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.description: Develops and supports software, services, devices and solutions including Azure Cloud, Microsoft 365, LinkedIn, and gaming.
MSFT.moat: Enterprise IT mission-critical stack, Azure hyperscale cloud infrastructure, and OpenAI enterprise partnership integration.
MSFT.invalidation_criteria: Loss of enterprise cloud market share to AWS/GCP, deceleration of Azure AI revenue below 15%, or significant margin compression.
MSFT.latest_catalyst: Copilot enterprise tier monetization and Azure AI capacity expansion.

NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.description: Pioneered accelerated computing to tackle challenges no one else can solve, dominating the data center GPU and AI hardware stack.
NVDA.moat: CUDA software ecosystem, proprietary interconnect (NVLink), full-stack AI data center architecture.
NVDA.invalidation_criteria: ASIC custom silicon replacing GPU demand in hyperscalers, CUDA fragmentation, or severe gross margin erosion below 65%.
NVDA.latest_catalyst: Blackwell B200 architecture volume ramp and sovereign AI infrastructure demand.

GOOGL.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class A)
GOOGL.description: Operates Google Search, YouTube, Android, Google Cloud, Waymo, and deep AI research through Google DeepMind.
GOOGL.moat: Global search monopoly, YouTube creator network effects, Google Cloud profitability ramp, custom TPU silicon.
GOOGL.invalidation_criteria: Structural loss of search query volume to conversational AI without offsetting search ad revenue or severe antitrust remedies.
GOOGL.latest_catalyst: Gemini model integration across Search & Workspace; GCP AI enterprise expansion.

GOOG.name: Alphabet Inc. (Class C)
GOOG.description: Non-voting Class C shares of Alphabet Inc., operating Google Search, YouTube, Android, Google Cloud, and DeepMind.
GOOG.moat: Global search monopoly, YouTube creator network effects, Google Cloud profitability ramp, custom TPU silicon.
GOOG.invalidation_criteria: Structural loss of search query volume to conversational AI without offsetting search ad revenue or severe antitrust remedies.
GOOG.latest_catalyst: Gemini model integration across Search & Workspace; GCP AI enterprise expansion.

AMZN.name: Amazon.com, Inc.
AMZN.description: Global e-commerce marketplace, cloud computing leader (AWS), digital advertising network, and logistics infrastructure.
AMZN.moat: Prime customer loyalty, unmatched regional fulfillment network, AWS cloud infrastructure scale, and high-margin ad network.
AMZN.invalidation_criteria: Slowing AWS growth below 10%, loss of retail market share, or regulatory forced unbundling of marketplace and logistics.
AMZN.latest_catalyst: AWS GenAI compute acceleration, retail margin expansion from regionalization, and Prime Video ad scaling.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.description: Builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Threads.
META.moat: 3.2B+ daily active users across family of apps, proprietary AI recommendation engine (Advantage+), open-source Llama model leadership.
META.invalidation_criteria: Deceleration of ad impression growth, massive uncontained Reality Labs burn (> $20B/yr without ROI), or severe user churn.
META.latest_catalyst: AI-driven ad conversion efficiency gains and WhatsApp business messaging monetization.

TSLA.name: Tesla, Inc.
TSLA.description: Designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and leases electric vehicles, energy storage systems, and solar installations.
TSLA.moat: Manufacturing scale, Supercharger network standard (NACS), Full Self-Driving neural network data fleet, Megapack energy storage growth.
TSLA.invalidation_criteria: Failure to achieve unsupervised FSD autonomy, severe automotive gross margin compression below 14%, or loss of EV market leadership.
TSLA.latest_catalyst: Robotaxi autonomous network reveal and Megapack Shanghai factory ramp.

AVGO.name: Broadcom Inc.
AVGO.description: Designs and supplies semiconductor devices and enterprise software including VMware, Symantec, and CA Technologies.
AVGO.moat: Dominant market share in custom AI XPUs (Google TPU, Meta ASIC), Tomahawk networking switches, VMware enterprise virtualization monopoly.
AVGO.invalidation_criteria: Loss of major custom ASIC hyperscaler accounts or severe customer pushback against VMware licensing price increases.
AVGO.latest_catalyst: Custom AI accelerator revenue doubling and VMware margin expansion.

COST.name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
COST.description: Operates membership warehouses based on the concept of offering low prices on a limited selection of brand-name and private-label products.
COST.moat: Scale economies shared, unmatched membership renewal rates (>93% North America), Kirkland Signature private brand power.
COST.invalidation_criteria: Sustained renewal rate deterioration below 88% or aggressive margin erosion from retail competitors.
COST.latest_catalyst: Global warehouse footprint expansion and membership fee increase realization.

NFLX.name: Netflix, Inc.
NFLX.description: The world's leading streaming entertainment service with over 275 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.
NFLX.moat: Massive global scale allowing highest content budget with lowest per-subscriber cost, profitable ad-supported tier, live sports programming.
NFLX.invalidation_criteria: Net subscriber losses over multiple quarters or content spend inflation outpacing revenue growth.
NFLX.latest_catalyst: Ad tier scaling, live events broadcast, and operating margin expansion reaching 28%.

AMD.name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
AMD.description: Develops high-performance computing, graphics, and visualization technologies including EPYC CPUs, Ryzen, and Instinct AI accelerators.
AMD.moat: EPYC server CPU market share momentum vs Intel, chiplet manufacturing architecture, open ROCm software stack.
AMD.invalidation_criteria: Failure of MI300/MI350 Instinct GPUs to capture >10% AI training/inference data center share.
AMD.latest_catalyst: MI325X and MI350 accelerator launch and EPYC Turin enterprise adoption.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.description: Builds software platforms for data-driven operations and decision making, including Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP), Foundry, and Gotham.
PLTR.moat: Ontology-driven architecture, mission-critical US defense/intelligence contracts, hyper-accelerating US Commercial AIP adoption.
PLTR.invalidation_criteria: Deceleration of US Commercial customer acquisition or failure of AIP bootcamps to convert to multi-year contracts.
PLTR.latest_catalyst: US Commercial customer count growth >80% YoY and S&P 500 inclusion index fund inflows.

MU.name: Micron Technology, Inc.
MU.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells memory and storage products including high-bandwidth memory (HBM3E), DRAM, and NAND flash.
MU.moat: Leading 1-beta DRAM node, sold-out HBM3E capacity for NVIDIA Blackwell AI accelerators, structural memory oligopoly with Samsung & SK Hynix.
MU.invalidation_criteria: Severe memory cyclical oversupply or aggressive price discounting by competitors.
MU.latest_catalyst: HBM3E high-volume delivery for AI data centers and edge AI DRAM content expansion.

CSCO.name: Cisco Systems, Inc.
CSCO.description: Global technology leader designing and selling IP networking, security, collaboration, and enterprise observability software (Splunk).
CSCO.moat: Pervasive enterprise networking footprint, Splunk data platform synergy, high recurring software ARR (>50%), 3.5% dividend yield.
CSCO.invalidation_criteria: Failure to capture AI data center Ethernet switching buildouts to Arista/white-box alternatives.
CSCO.latest_catalyst: Splunk integration cross-selling, Silicon One AI networking architecture wins.

AMAT.name: Applied Materials, Inc.
AMAT.description: Provides manufacturing equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor, display, and related industries.
AMAT.moat: Broadest portfolio of wafer fab equipment (materials engineering, deposition, etch), critical enabling tech for Gate-All-Around (GAA) nodes.
AMAT.invalidation_criteria: Severe geopolitical export bans drastically curbing wafer fab equipment deliveries to key regions.
AMAT.latest_catalyst: Gate-All-Around transistor transition and advanced packaging materials engineering demand.

LRCX.name: Lam Research Corporation
LRCX.description: Designs, manufactures, markets, and services semiconductor processing equipment used in the fabrication of integrated circuits.
LRCX.moat: Monopolistic market share in advanced dielectric etch and deposition for 3D NAND memory and advanced logic nodes.
LRCX.invalidation_criteria: Prolonged freeze in memory fab capex spending or share loss in atomic layer etching.
LRCX.latest_catalyst: 3D NAND layer count escalation (300+ layers) and cryogenic etch tool adoption.

TMUS.name: T-Mobile US, Inc.
TMUS.description: Provides wireless voice, messaging, and data services under the T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile brands, and fixed wireless 5G home internet.
TMUS.moat: Mid-band 5G spectrum lead, lowest cost-per-gigabyte network architecture, dominant share of postpaid phone net additions.
TMUS.invalidation_criteria: Broadband market share losses to fiber overbuilders or destructive price competition from cable MVNOs.
TMUS.latest_catalyst: 5G Home Internet fixed wireless expansion and massive shareholder capital return via dividends and buybacks.

LIN.name: Linde PLC
LIN.description: Leading global industrial gases and engineering company serving chemicals, refining, healthcare, electronics, and manufacturing.
LIN.moat: Oligopolistic pricing power, long-term take-or-pay on-site pipeline contracts (15-20 years), essential input for high-tech semiconductor fabs.
LIN.invalidation_criteria: Severe industrial slowdown across Europe/Americas coupled with capital allocation missteps.
LIN.latest_catalyst: Clean hydrogen project contracts and ultra-high-purity gas delivery to new semiconductor fabs.

INTC.name: Intel Corporation
INTC.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells computer products and technologies including client CPUs, data center processors, and Intel Foundry.
INTC.moat: x86 architecture patent estate, CHIPS Act direct subsidies, domestic US wafer fab footprint.
INTC.invalidation_criteria: Yield failure on 18A process node or further market share collapse in data center server CPUs.

PEP.name: PepsiCo, Inc.
PEP.description: Global food and beverage leader with complementary brands across Frito-Lay, Quaker, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, and Tropicana.
PEP.moat: Direct-Store-Delivery (DSD) logistics network, global snacking brand dominance (Doritos, Lay's), pricing power, 50+ consecutive years of dividend increases.
PEP.invalidation_criteria: Structural consumer volume decline in North American convenience snacking.
PEP.latest_catalyst: International snack market expansion and supply chain productivity optimization.

KLAC.name: KLA Corporation
KLAC.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets process control and yield management solutions for the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
KLAC.moat: Near-monopoly (>55% market share) in optical wafer inspection and metrology; essential for sub-3nm chip fabrication yield.
KLAC.invalidation_criteria: Technological disruption by e-beam inspection competitors or prolonged semiconductor fab capex freeze.

AMGN.name: Amgen Inc.
AMGN.description: Discovers, develops, manufactures, and delivers human therapeutics across oncology, inflammation, and general medicine.
AMGN.moat: Biologics manufacturing scale, patent-protected commercial therapies (Prolia, Repatha, Tezspire), Horizon Therapeutics rare disease portfolio.
AMGN.invalidation_criteria: MariTide obesity drug clinical trial disappointment or major biosimilar price competition.

TXN.name: Texas Instruments Incorporated
TXN.description: Designs and manufactures analog and embedded processing chips for industrial, automotive, personal electronics, and communications equipment.

TXN.invalidation_criteria: Prolonged inventory overhang in automotive/industrial markets or aggressive Chinese mature-node analog dumping.

GILD.name: Gilead Sciences, Inc.

ISRG.name: Intuitive Surgical, Inc.

ADI.name: Analog Devices, Inc.

HON.name: Honeywell International Inc.

QCOM.name: QUALCOMM Incorporated
QCOM.description: Develops foundational technologies for wireless communications (5G, 6G), mobile Snapdragon processors, automotive digital cockpits, and AI PCs.

BKNG.name: Booking Holdings Inc.

PANW.name: Palo Alto Networks, Inc.

APP.name: AppLovin Corporation
APP.description: Builds software-based platforms for mobile app developers to enhance marketing and monetization using its AI recommendation engine (AXON 2.0).

APP.invalidation_criteria: Major mobile OS privacy rule revisions disabling ad measurement or failure of e-commerce web ad pilots.

INTU.name: Intuit Inc.
INTU.description: Provides financial management, compliance, and marketing products including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma, and Mailchimp.

ASML.name: ASML Holding N.V.
ASML.description: Manufacturer of photolithography systems used in semiconductor manufacturing, with an exclusive monopoly in extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography.

ASML.invalidation_criteria: Breakthrough alternative non-optical lithography technology (nanoimprint) gaining viable commercial traction.

VRTX.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated
VRTX.description: Discovers and develops transformative medicines for serious diseases including cystic fibrosis (Trikafta), sickle cell (CASGEVY), and acute pain (Suzetrigine).

CMCSA.description: Media and technology company providing broadband, video, mobile, and theme parks through Xfinity, NBCUniversal, Peacock, and Sky.

CEG.name: Constellation Energy Corporation
